description: Prepare cancelling a maker's Midnight offer groups through MidnightBundlesV2. First call `morpho_midnight_list_user_offer_groups` for the maker's group IDs. Cancels each group whatever has already been filled. Returns unsigned transactions, approval and MidnightBundlesV2 authorization first, plus a simulation and warnings.

groups.description: Offer group IDs to cancel (`id` from `morpho_midnight_list_user_offer_groups`)

name: morpho_prepare_midnight_cancel_offers
